'''Grom Zian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the planet [[Solu Five]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, during the [[Galactic War]], he was bought off by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and at the behest of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] he attempted to sideline the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] unit [[Havoc Squad]] with a Senate hearing about their activities&mdash;only for the unit's [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commander]] to expose him using evidence gathered by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].

==Biography==
Zian was the Senator of [[Solu Five]]. Bought off by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Zian, with the aid of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], slowly gained influence within the Senate. By the start of the [[Galactic War]], Zian, on orders from General [[Arkos Rakton]], launched an inquiry into the activities of [[Republic Special Forces Division]], specifically [[Havoc Squad]], Rakton's arch-enemy. It was Rakton's intention to get Havoc suspended to turn the war in his favor by having Zian portray the squad's commander as a loose cannon.

During the hearing, Zian began listing allegations against Havoc, including the disappearance of [[Harron Tavus]], the destruction of the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the initial cause of Rakton's campaign, and their apparent lack of involvement in the war effort. When it came to the Havoc Squad Commander to speak, the Commander presented evidence gathered by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] proving Zian's Imperial ties. Zian attempted to dismiss them as "wild accusations" or "paranoid delusions", but Senator [[Zorin Krasul]], whom Havoc saved on a previous mission, stating that the CO of Havoc Squad deserves more than to be dismissed. After the Senate Committee reviewed the evidence, they ordered the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Senate Guard]] to detain Zian for [[Treason/Legends|high treason]]. As he is hauled away, Zian weakly protested that the evidence was forged as part of some military conspiracy.

==Behind the scenes==
===Fate===
The player can either choose to present the evidence against Zian or outright kill him.
